retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban scene featuring a burning suburban house juxtaposed with luxury sports cars and vibrant, overgrown flora.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex digital collage merging a gritty urban reality with surreal elements: a modest white house engulfed in intense orange flames and thick black smoke, flanked by high-end sports cars, set within a lush, unnaturally vibrant garden under a hazy, sepia-toned sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition of extreme wealth (luxury cars) and destruction (burning modest home)
Contrast between the warm, destructive fire and the cool, vibrant blue-green flora
Vertical tension between the rising smoke/fire and the horizontal grounding of the cars and house
coreInvariants: Intense orange and red fire with heavy dark smoke
A central white suburban house with a chain-link fence
Vibrant, saturated wildflowers in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The burning house is the central focal point, scaled to dominate the middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow sports car on the left and the dark grey sports car on the right anchor the lower corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright yellow car, moves to the central figure and house, then follows the smoke upward toward the birds in the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with detail, using smoke to fill the upper third.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and orange (fire, sky, smoke)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow (car) and deep red (fire core)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the fire and flowers against a desaturated, hazy background.

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a white rectangular badge

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family condensed sans-serif for all technical labels.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for warning labels.
Offers a cleaner, more modern look while maintaining the verticality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic scene of a white suburban house on fire with thick black smoke rising into a yellow-hazy sky. Place a yellow sports car on the left and a dark grey sports car on the right. The foreground should be filled with vibrant, overgrown wildflowers and puddles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small white rectangular badge in the bottom right corner containing bold, black, condensed sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the fire the primary light source?
Are the cars modern luxury models?
Is the sky a hazy, polluted yellow/orange?
Are the flowers in the foreground unnaturally vibrant?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lighting on the cars matches the fire source
Verify the 'warning badge' is legible and correctly placed
Confirm the atmosphere feels heavy and hazy
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Chaos = (Modest Architecture + Intense Fire/Smoke) * (Luxury Assets) + (Vibrant Overgrown Nature) / (Hazy Sepia Atmosphere)
